name: ServiceRequestSourceFieldProjection
input: accepted validated Advanced Search field deltas for one exact surviving Service Request plus source_evidence_id/source chronology
transaction: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork after workbook parsing/staging/review completes outside the write lock
steps: resolve exact service_request_id from accepted SR identity/adoption decision
for each allowlisted active field independently classify accepted value as usable, non-usable warning, unchanged usable, or reviewed correction/reversal
for unchanged usable field create no redundant field observation
for new/changed usable field insert append-only sr_source_field_observations row
compare source chronology with current pointer for that field and update only the applicable projection pointer according to accepted precedence
never clear a current pointer from missing/blank/malformed/unknown evidence unless that field's explicit contract permits clearing
insert bounded review/warning references through the owning reconciliation evidence model
increment projection revision only when at least one current pointer changes
commit accepted field deltas/projection pointers/receipt/audit atomically
field_independence: A newer row is not a whole-record replacement. Problem Summary, Report Date, Contact label, Severity, Handler, Status, Customer label/code, suspend facts and Last Update each select their own newest accepted usable observation.
terminal_reversal: recognized terminal-to-nonterminal Status never follows ordinary pointer replacement; it enters a high-risk correction path bound to exact prior terminal evidence, and rejection leaves current terminal pointer unchanged.
reference_reconciliation: Customer Organization/Contact labels and Customer Account Code remain source evidence. LLD-02 candidate matching/review may establish reusable references, but unresolved/ambiguous references do not block persistence of the otherwise valid SR and never replace source observation history.
rebuild: sr_current_source_projection can be rebuilt deterministically from append-only observations and accepted review/correction evidence; rebuild cannot create new domain history or audit events.
